core_obligations: Part (1): lift the map on the degree zero term by freeness, note that the induced map on the next term lands in the image of the resolution's differential, lift again, and repeat (proof lines 17740-17749).

Part (2): it suffices to homotope the difference gamma to zero; lift gamma_0 to h_0, correct gamma_1 by the composite with the differential to land in a kernel, lift again, and repeat (proof lines 17752-17762).
proof_roadmap: Build the comparison map by iterated lifting (proof lines 17739-17749).
Build the homotopy by the same iterated lifting applied to the difference (proof lines 17751-17763).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a map M to N, any resolution of N and any free complex mapping to M, there is a map of complexes lifting the given square, and any two such maps are homotopic (statement lines 17716-17737). The proof does not use a general lifting theorem for projective complexes: it lifts degree by degree using freeness of the terms, and repeats the same device for the difference of two comparison maps, correcting each degree so that the next lift lands in a kernel (proof lines 17739-17763). Seeing that the homotopy is the same lifting argument applied to the difference is the content, and the author writes the induction steps out in both parts. H2.
